paite: Ngai in, TOUPA ni, na gallak na lak a hawm a a-om ding hun ahong tung hi.
heading: Jerusalem Leh Namte Kidouna
english: Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

paite: Jerusalem dou a galdou ding in nam tengteng ka kaikhawm ding a; khopi lak in a-om dia, innte lok in leh numeite sualluih in a-om ding uh; khopi kimkhat sal a kaih in a-om ding a, khopi a kipan mikhosuaksunte kuamah satkhiak in a-om kei ding uhi.
english: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

paite: Huai ni chiang in TOUPA apaikhe dia, kidou lai a adou bang in huai namte adou ding hi.
english: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

paite: Huai ni chiang in akhe a Jerusalem suahlam a om, Olive Tang sik in adingh dia, huchi in Olive Tang bel suahlam a pan tumlam ah phel nih kisuah in akiphelkhap ding hi, huchi in phaizang thupi mahmah ahong omta ding a; tang kimkhat mallam ah leh akimkhat simlam ah akikhin ding hi. Huchi in phaizang lam ah ka mualte na taikek ding uhi.
english: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

paite: Mualte phaizang Azal tung ding ahi ngal a; ahi, Judah kumpipa Uzziah dam lai a zinling ma a kipan na taikek uh bang in; huchi in TOUPA ka Pathian ahong pai ding a, akiang ah misiangthoute ahon tonpih ding hi.
english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

paite: Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, khovot a-om kei dia, vuk a-om sam kei ding.
english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

paite: Himahleh TOUPA a dia theih a om ni khat ahi ding; sun hilou, zan hilou; himahleh hichi ahi ding a, nitaklam in khovak a-om ding hi.
english: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

paite: Huan huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in tui hingte aluangkhe dia; alak ua kimkhat suahlam tuipi ah, alak ua kimkhat tumlam tuipi ah; nipi leh phalbi in a-omden ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

paite: Huchi in leitung tengteng ah TOUPA kumpipa ahi ding; huai ni chiang in TOUPA khat amin khat ahi ding hi.
english: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

paite: Jerusalem sim Geba a kipan Rimmon tan, gam tengteng phaizang asuak ding a; Jerusalem bel Benjamin kongpi a kipan kongpi khatna chiang, aning a kongpi chiang, Hananel insang a kipan kumpipa uain sukna pha a kipan khentuam in a-om ding hi.
heading: TOUPA Vualzohna Leh Vaihawmna
english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

paite: Huai ah mite ateng ding ua, hamsia a-om nawn kei dia; himahleh Jerusalem ah muangtak in ateng ding uhi.
english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

paite: Huan Jerusalem kidoupih mite tengteng TOUPA'N agawtna ding hipi bel hiai ahi ding; akhe ua adin lai un, asa uh amuat ding a, amit hawm sung uah amit uh amuat ding, akamsung uah alei uh amuat ding hi.
english: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

paite: Huai ni chiang in hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA a kipan nakpitak a buaina alak uah ahong om ding a; michih in a-invengte khut ah alen tinten ding a, a-invengte khut dou ding in akhut akisa ding hi.
english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

paite: Judah in leng Jerusalem ah adou dia; kho kim khovel a nam tengteng hauhsakna dangka-eng, dangka, puansilh atam a tam in alakhawm ding hi.
english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

paite: Huchibang in hiai gawtna hipi gamsa tengteng leh sakol, sakolneu, sangawngsau leh sabiltungte puaninte ah hiai gawtna a-om ding hi.
english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, Jerusalem dou ding a hong kuan nam tengteng lak a nutsiat a om michih akum sik in Kumpipa, sepaihte' TOUPA, be ding leh Biakbukte Ankuangluina nei ding in Jerusalem ah akuantou ding uhi.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

paite: Hichi ahi ding a, leitung a inkuan tengteng, Jerusalem a Kumpipa, sepaihte' TOUPA, be ding a hohtou lou peuhmah, atung uah vuah azu kei ding hi.
english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

paite: Aigupta inkuan ahohtouh louh ua, ahong pai kei uleh, amaute tung ah leng vuah azu kei ding; Biakbuk Ankuangluina nei ding a hohtou lou namte gawtna ding hipi a-om zaw ding hi.
english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

paite: Hiai Aigupta gawtna bel Biakbuk Ankuangluina nei ding a hoh lou nam tengteng gawtna ahi ding hi.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

paite: Huai ni chiang in sakol longte ah, TOUPA A DING A SIANGTHOU, chih akigelh ding a; TOUPA' inn a belte maitam ma a noubemte bang ahi ding uhi.
english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

paite: Ahi, Jerusalem leh Judah a bel tengteng sepaihte' TOUPA a ding in siangthou ahi ding uh; akithoihte ahong pai ding ua huai belte la in kithoihna sa ahuan ding uhi, huai ni chiang in sepaihte' TOUPA' inn ah Kanaan mi a-om nawn kei ding hi.
english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of Yahweh of Armies.
